intro: About 160 kcal for 1 stick of pulut panggang. Most of the calories come from glutinous rice cooked in santan.

variants.name: Pulut panggang with sweet coconut filling

diet: Yes, one stick of pulut panggang is still moderate. Pulut is quite dense, so it's easy to want a second stick. For breakfast, one stick with an unsweetened drink is good enough. Try not to make it an extra snack after a heavy meal.
tips: Count one stick as one snack, not 'just a small one'.
Choose udang kering or fish filling, which has a bit of protein compared to the sweet filling.
Drink plain water or teh O kosong with it, not teh tarik.

swap.name: Kuih koci 1 piece
swap.why: Smaller size and still has that pulut taste, good when you just want a little.

faq.q: Where does pulut panggang come from?
faq.a: It's popular all over the Peninsula, especially in Johor, Melaka and Kelantan. It's wrapped in banana leaf and grilled over charcoal.
Grilling gives it a fragrant banana leaf smell and a slightly crispy outside.
Yes. When you want to eat it, heat it in the oven or on a dry pan without oil.
